display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-06 Fire prevention and mitigation for EVs in confined areas (2ZERO Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-06 Fire prevention and mitigation for EVs in confined areas (2ZERO Partnership)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Innovation Action under the 2ZERO partnership (Towards zero emission road transport) that funds a European database of electric-vehicle fire accidents, mitigation of battery thermal runaway, on-board diagnosis and early warning, affordable fire detection, prevention and suppression in confined spaces such as underground car parks, garages, ferries and depots (including during charging), firefighting protocols aligned with existing standards, and public awareness, up to TRL 6. Social sciences and humanities expertise is required. Open to consortia under the standard Horizon Europe rules; funded as a lump sum at Innovation Action rates (70% for for-profit entities, 100% for non-profit). Indicative topic budget EUR 8 million for one project of around EUR 8 million. Planned opening 15 December 2026; single-stage deadline 14 April 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 8 (Climate, Energy and Mobility), pp. 225–227, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope of HORIZON-CL5-2027-03-D5-06, funds fire-risk assessment, detection, suppression and firefighting protocols for electric vehicles in confined spaces such as car parks, garages, ferries and depots. It does not touch TenneT's field: the hazards and solutions concern vehicles and parking facilities, not transmission assets, grid operation or the substations TenneT runs, and no project file is close to it. Both project dates are null because the call states no start, end or duration.
